contracts: Original-only C++ header/helper callers and full model quantizer captures precede maintained Rust implementation; 463 type and 88 file cases per host.
Complete successful output lengths and SHA-256 are exact; no tolerance relaxation.
Type planner covers all 35 file quantizer modes and frozen mixed precision order; canonical architecture registry does not imply inference support.
Native ordering sorts by leading blk.%d layer first, then byte name; split preservation sorts by shard and physical offset.
Output publication stages conversion before per-file atomic rename; several shard renames are not a filesystem-wide transaction.
Rust payload slabs have explicit hard limits, one-row minimum, retained handles, and typed expert importance rows.
General model metadata geometry is required; exotic/non-attention architectures remain explicit unsupported outcomes until independently characterized.
Native assertions/abort boundaries are checked errors; previous complete destinations survive conversion failure.
GNU regex policy is additive; existing grammar callers keep their MSVC profile.
Source generators and foreign implementations remain external to the product.
